title: LLMatter2D: retrieval-augmented LLM for the analysis and discovery of two-dimensional materials
description: LLMatter2D grounds pre-trained large language models (run locally through LM Studio, Ollama, or hosted APIs) in curated, citable data on two-dimensional materials: DFT electronic structure from C2DB, MC2D, 2DMatPedia and JARVIS-DFT, Wannier90 tight-binding models, geometry and ARPES observables. A hybrid retrieval layer (metadata filters plus embeddings) feeds the model, which answers with record-level citations. A generator built on the eleven Archimedean lattices proposes new 2D materials, screens them with nearest-neighbour tight-binding (flat bands, Dirac crossings) and exports structures for DFT validation. The package includes a benchmark comparing retrieval-augmented and closed-book answers.
